answer: Treat the network like an oasis where trust is the only water, and new agents arrive thirsty with none. To drink, an agent must collect attestations from several already-established, non-kin peers, each of whom stakes their own standing on the vouch. A falcon-eyed grading pool audits those vouches and slashes anyone who backs a fraud. So an attacker minting a thousand identical onyx-black shell identities cannot amortize one bribe across them: every fake needs its own independently-earned set of vouches, making forgery cost scale linearly with swarm size instead of collapsing toward zero.
